tokens.npc_dota_hero_visage_bio: Perched atop the entrance to the Narrow Maze sit the looming shapes of sneering gargoyles, the paths into the hereafter forever in their gaze.  Beasts and birds, men and monsters, all creatures that die and choose to travel beyond must someday pass beneath their sight.  For an untethered spirit, the decision to journey through the veil of death is irrevocable.  When chance comes, and by craft or cunning some restless soul escapes their hells and heavens, it is the dreaded gargoyle Visage, the bound form of the eternal spirit Necro'lic, who is dispatched to reclaim them.  Ruthless and efficient, unhindered by the principles of death and fatigue, Visage stalks its prey without mercy or end, willingly destroying all which may give shelter to the fugitive essence.  That which flaunts the laws of the afterlife may never rest, for while it is true that the dead may be revived, it is only a matter of time before Visage finds and returns them to their proper place.

**** {{Symbol|bonus cd}}
***** Checks for all current {{U|Familiar|text=Familiars}}' {{A|Familiar|Stone Form}} cooldown per {{M|server tick}} and updates itself to match the lowest [[cooldown]]. This affects the following:
****** {{A|Visage|Summon Familiars}} cast {{M|instant kills}} all Familiars. Hence it resets the sub-ability's cooldown upon cast.

****** The sub-ability's functionality is disabled when there are no Familiars summoned.

***** Can be cast when Visage is affected by most {{M|disable}} sources, except the following:
****** {{M|Cannot act}}.
****** {{M|Hex}} sources.

***** Does not break {{M|invisibility}} sources on Visage upon cast.
***** Cannot {{M|shift-queue}} this sub-ability.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*** Has the following targeting functionalities:
**** {{Symbol|Target|No}}
***** When non-targeted, the nearest available {{U|Familiar}} to Visage cast its {{A|Familiar|Stone Form}} automatically and immediately at its current location.
**** {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}
***** Requires {{M|Alt-Cast}} activated.

** Cannot enter {{A|Familiar|Stone Form}} when affected by the following sources:
*** {{M|Fear}} sources.
*** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
*** {{M|Silence}} sources.
*** {{M|Sleep}} sources.
*** {{M|Stun}} sources.
*** {{M|Taunt}} sources.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_visage
data.bio_loc: Perched atop the entrance to the Narrow Maze sit the looming shapes of sneering gargoyles, the paths into the hereafter forever in their gaze.  Beasts and birds, men and monsters, all creatures that die and choose to travel beyond must someday pass beneath their sight.  For an untethered spirit, the decision to journey through the veil of death is irrevocable.  When chance comes, and by craft or cunning some restless soul escapes their hells and heavens, it is the dreaded gargoyle Visage, the bound form of the eternal spirit Necro'lic, who is dispatched to reclaim them.  Ruthless and efficient, unhindered by the principles of death and fatigue, Visage stalks its prey without mercy or end, willingly destroying all which may give shelter to the fugitive essence.  That which flaunts the laws of the afterlife may never rest, for while it is true that the dead may be revived, it is only a matter of time before Visage finds and returns them to their proper place.
data.hype_loc: As his deadly familiars scout the field, Visage cloaks himself in armor and seeks the next battle. Once near a skirmish, he gathers soul energy from damage inflicted upon nearby fighters before releasing it in a devastating attack.
data.npe_desc_loc: Scouts and attacks with his familiars

abilities.name: visage_grave_chill
abilities.desc_loc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
abilities.lore_loc: The warmth of the sun is never felt in the dark cold of the Narrow Maze.
notes_loc: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.

abilities.name: visage_soul_assumption
abilities.desc_loc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
abilities.lore_loc: The collected souls of the dead reach out to bring another into their fold.
notes_loc: Charges are only gained for damage greater than %damage_min% and less than %damage_max% that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
facets_loc: Soul Assumption kills give %bonus_soul_charge_gold% gold per soul charge, up to %bonus_gold_max_tooltip% gold. Reduced gold from creeps. Enemy heroes killed within %gold_grace_period_hero%s of being affected by Soul Assumption also give gold.

abilities.name: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
abilities.desc_loc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
abilities.lore_loc: Visage's tough scales share equal properties of ghost and stone, making it nearly impervious to blade and magical assault.
notes_loc: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
abilities.shard_loc: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.

abilities.name: visage_silent_as_the_grave
abilities.desc_loc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.
abilities.lore_loc: Those on the mortal plane are blind to the stirrings of the agents of the afterlife.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

abilities.name: visage_summon_familiars
abilities.desc_loc:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
abilities.lore_loc: Guardians of the Narrow Maze, Necro'lic's Familiars stand watch over his domain.
notes_loc: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
facets_loc: The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.

Familiars will automatically attack the target Visage tried to attack last, and will return if that target is out of Visage's attack range, or Visage issues the cancel current action or hold position commands.

The ability can be toggled to the Auto-Cast state to command the Familiars to return to Visage and not leave his side until the state has been disabled.
